value.title: River Crossing Operation
value.synopsis: Chirico Cuvie joins the invasion of a Balarant Union stronghold, but the Balarant defenses are up to the challenge of the assault.

value.title: Galeade
value.synopsis: Chirico lands on the planet Galeade, where he meets the members of his new squadron under the command of Barkoff... but for what purpose have they been brought together?

value.title: The Unit
value.synopsis: A fifth member is added to Barkoff's team, but is he an asset or a liability?

value.title: The Valley of Death
value.synopsis: A botched mission leads to disastrous consequences for the Gilgamesh Army.

value.title: Interrogation
value.synopsis: Defiant against even insurmountable opposition, Pailsen resists attempts at interrogation, but his silence is no match for the insidious MRC device.

value.title: Superpower
value.synopsis: As the MRC continues its torturous work, Pailsen reveals the truth behind Chirico's seeming invincibility.

value.title: Sniping
value.synopsis: Barkoff's team is ordered to a base near the planet's north pole, but a malfunction with their transport plane leaves them unexpectedly stranded.

value.title: Frozen Prison
value.synopsis: A new crisis threatens to wipe out the planet's atmosphere, but the changing weather isn't the only threat looming on the horizon...

value.title: Downburst
value.synopsis: With time running out, the team must concoct a PRL formula that can withstand the oncoming extreme cold. Meanwhile, Wappe sets off on a mission of his own.

value.title: Strategic Motion
value.synopsis: Wokkam proposes a major attack on Monad, the Balarant fortress-planet, but there is more to this attack than meets the eye.

value.title: The Immortal Unit
value.synopsis: As Gilgamesh operatives invade Monad, Chirico's origins are at last brought to light.

value.title: Monad
value.synopsis: Time is running out as Monad spirals toward destruction. Can Chirico make it out in time, or is his journey fated to end at last?
